backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing user profiles, goals, progress data, and authorization with create/view/update functions and data models for tasks, milestones, and reviews.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a scrollability fix in GoalLibraryModal to affected frontend file and associated components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing functionality of various frontend components, hooks, pages, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH design tokens, light/dark theme variables, and global background/foreground behavior.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the root React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling auth, profile setup, automatic goal library prompts, theme provider, routing, and global toasts.
frontend/src/components/AutoPlanner/Auto: Auto‑planner input component allowing manual or template‑based goal entry with duration selection and plan generation.
Auto‑planner review and save flow enabling users to edit generated plan items and create a goal with milestones and tasks in the backend.
Manages the Auto Planner flow, switching between goal input and review steps and storing the generated plan.
frontend/src/components/DailyCheckIn.tsx: Displays daily tasks, tracks completions and missed reasons, and submits daily check‑ins while preventing duplicate submissions.
frontend/src/components/DashboardHome.ts: Renders the dashboard landing page with a hero section, locked‑in goals, and navigation shortcuts to major app sections.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple footer showing attribution, links, and app version.
frontend/src/components/GoalDefinitionFl: Guides users through defining a goal, timeframe, and motivation, then submits the new goal.
frontend/src/components/GoalDetail.tsx: Displays detailed goal info with tabs for planning, daily check‑ins, and weekly reviews, and includes goal deletion handling.
frontend/src/components/GoalLibraryModal: Modal for browsing goal templates, selecting multiple, and creating goals from templates with feedback and error handling.
frontend/src/components/GoalsOverview.ts: Displays a list of user goals with options to create new goals or open the goal library, and handles navigation to goal details.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the app header with login, theme toggle, accent color selection, and profile navigation features.
frontend/src/components/lockedIn/CheckIn: Visual ticker and stats display showing the last 7 days of check‑ins and completion rates for a goal.
frontend/src/components/lockedIn/LockedI: Lists locked‑in goals with check‑in controls, stats, and navigation to create new auto‑planned goals.
frontend/src/components/PlanningPhase.ts: Guides users through adding milestones and tasks for a goal and allows locking in the completed plan.
frontend/src/components/profile/emojiOpt: Exports a fixed list of emoji options for profile selection.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Provides a modal for creating or updating a user profile with name and avatar selection.
frontend/src/components/SettingsPanel.ts: Allows users to update profile info, copy their principal, and sign out within a settings interface.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyPlan/Weekl: Shows weekly planning options based on locked-in goals and links to the auto planner when no plans exist.
Expandable goal card showing metrics, upcoming milestones, and weekly tasks using multiple query hooks.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyReview.tsx: Weekly review form that tracks task completion, computes completion rate, and submits a progress summary.
frontend/src/contexts/DashboardNavigatio: Context provider managing active dashboard section and supplying setter to consumers.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccentPreset.ts: Hook managing accent color presets, syncing them to CSS variables and local storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and refreshes a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity auth flow, stored identities, and login state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, goals, and related entities via an actor backend, including creation and template-based goal operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes, including semantic and legacy LockedIn color tokens.
frontend/src/lib/autoPlanner/generatePla: Generates a structured plan with milestones and tasks based on a goal description, timeframe, and optional custom duration.
frontend/src/lib/goalTemplates.ts: Contains predefined goal templates with metadata, milestones, and tasks across categories like study, fitness, and productivity.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app, wrapping it with Internet Identity and React Query providers before rendering.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Implements the main dashboard UI with navigation, goal selection, and routing between sections like goals, milestones, daily tasks, and settings.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the marketing-style homepage with a login button and feature highlights using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/utils/dates.ts: Provides helpers to convert bigint nanosecond timestamps to Date objects and format them into date, datetime, relative time, and UTC day keys.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Extracts readable error messages from unknown values, handling Error objects, strings, and structured agent/Candid errors.
frontend/src/utils/trackingMetrics.ts: Computes recent check-in stats and goal metrics, including counts and completion rates based on DailyCheckIn and WeeklyReview data.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, layout, animations, and plugin usage for the frontend theme.
project_state.json: Project state file outlining current issues, features, and metadata for the goal library scrollability fix.
